## Pre-registered effects (arm full)

1. Maximum block span >= 20: 21.9 -> **holds**.
2. First session with span >= 80 in [250, 865]: per seed [None, None, None] -> **fails, never**; span at 865 15.7 [15.5-16.0] (DD 104).
3. 4-digit error > 3-digit error (250-865): 0.269 vs 0.096 -> **holds** (EPAM 3.0% vs 1.5%).
4. Prior speeds early learning (span s50 full vs prioroff): 11.5 vs 9.5 -> **holds**.
5. Letter probe final <= 9 at every probe: max 11 -> **fails**.
- actoff: span s865 full vs actoff per seed [('15.5', '10.0'), ('15.7', '8.9'), ('16.0', '8.0')] -> full beats it on every seed: **True**.
- conceptsoff: span s865 full vs conceptsoff per seed [('15.5', '15.6'), ('15.7', '16.5'), ('16.0', '22.5')] -> full beats it on every seed: **False**.
